post.caption:
Chlorophyll dominates all summer. As days shorten the tree reabsorbs it, revealing the carotenoids that were there the whole time. Reds are the exception: anthocyanins are produced fresh in autumn. The colour is a nutrient withdrawal process, not decoration.
